propositions: bridge_project and repos fields must be added to ticket state schema and seeded in make_initial_state with tri-state (absent/empty/value) and list-of-strings types respectively
bridge_project and repos must be projected by the reducer from both CREATE and EDIT events, and create-time arguments must be added to all three write surfaces (CLI, library, MCP)
bridge_project is promote-only: edits setting bridge_project on a ticket with an existing binding must be refused with non-zero exit and no state change, while edits on unbound tickets must succeed
repos must be freely editable on the edit path without binding constraints, while bridge_project edit-time guard reads bindings.json via _load_binding_reverse to determine if a binding exists
CLI flag parser must register new flags or raise hard errors for unknown options, and cross-surface parity must hold: CLI, library, and MCP create paths must produce identical ticket state
tickets created before this change must replay to identical state apart from the two new keys
